mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.login_help: Enter your second verification code to finish signing in.
mfa.cancel_login: Cancel and return to sign in
mfa.optional_help: Add extra protection to your account. Setup is optional; your current sign-in continues until setup is complete. Add both methods and choose one when signing in.
mfa.disabled: Two-step verification is not enabled yet.
mfa.save_codes: Save your recovery codes somewhere safe
mfa.codes_help: These codes are shown only now. Each code works once. Generating new codes invalidates the previous codes. Completing setup signs out your other devices.
mfa.saved: I saved my codes; hide them
mfa.reauth_help: To change security settings, sign in with your second step within the last 5 minutes.
mfa.unavailable: Setup is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
mfa.password: Your current password to confirm this change
mfa.google_proof: You just signed in with Google, so you can leave the password blank.
mfa.scan_help: Scan the QR code using Google Authenticator or a compatible app, then enter its 6-digit code.
mfa.manual_key: You can also enter this key manually:
mfa.email_setup_help: We sent a code to your verified email address. Enter the 6-digit code to finish setup.
mfa.confirm_recovery: Your previous recovery codes will stop working and your other devices will be signed out. Store the new codes somewhere safe.
mfa.confirm_disable: Two-step verification will be turned off and your other devices will be signed out. Continue?
mfa.reminder: Protect your owner/admin account with two-step verification. Setup is optional for now.
mfa.error.default: We could not complete this action. Please try again.
mfa.error.MfaChallengeExpired: Verification expired or the attempt limit was reached. Please start again.
mfa.error.MfaCodeInvalid: This code is invalid, expired or already used. Try a new code.
mfa.error.MfaResendLimited: Too many codes requested. Try again after the indicated wait.
mfa.error.MfaPasswordRequired: Enter your current password or sign in again with Google.
mfa.error.MfaReauthenticationRequired: Sign in again with two-step verification to continue.
mfa.error.MfaUnavailable: This method is currently unavailable. Use a recovery code or try again later.
mfa.error.MfaEmailUnavailable: We could not send the email. Try again later or use another method.
mfa.error.MfaAlreadyEnabled: This method is already enabled. Refresh your settings.
mfa.error.MfaMethodUnavailable: This verification method is not available for your account.
